profile.name: 并行任务队列
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于实验相关的并行计算与数据处理流程。它负责向工作进程分发任务、接收已完成结果、归档结果，并统计开放、进行中和已完成的任务数量。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component used in experiment-related parallel computation and data-processing workflows. It distributes tasks to workers, receives completed results, files results, and tracks open, in-progress, and completed task counts.
